stories.headline: Christian metal band Demon Hunter sues Netflix, says 'KPop Demon Hunters' caused 'existential crisis'
stories.summary: The Christian heavy metal group Demon Hunter has taken legal action against Netflix alongside live-event promoter AEG Presents. The musicians contend that a successful animated project titled *KPop Demon Hunters* unlawfully borrows their established brand and creates deceptive commercial rivalry. The filing challenges both entertainment corporations over their use of the band's distinctive moniker.
